description: This Python script applies database schema migrations to a Supabase backend by extracting SQL statements from a markdown file, executing them via the Supabase SQL HTTP endpoint, ensuring a storage bucket exists, and verifying the existence of certain tables and indexes. It serves as a migration and setup utility for the project.

methods.name: str _read_sql_blocks_from_markdown(md_path: str)
methods.description: Extracts SQL code blocks from a markdown file.

methods.name: List[str] _split_sql_statements(sql: str)
methods.description: Splits a block of SQL text into individual statements.

methods.name: str _sql_endpoint_url(supabase_url: str)
methods.description: Constructs the SQL HTTP endpoint URL for Supabase.

methods.name: Tuple[int,dict] _exec_sql(supabase_url: str, service_key: str, statement: str)
methods.description: Executes a single SQL statement via the Supabase SQL endpoint.

methods.name: None _ensure_storage_bucket(supabase_url: str, service_key: str, bucket: str, public: bool = False)
methods.description: Creates a storage bucket if it does not already exist.

methods.name: dict _verify_objects(supabase_url: str, service_key: str)
methods.description: Verifies the existence of specific tables, indexes, and storage bucket.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Main function to run the migration process, apply schema, ensure storage, verify existence, and output a summary.

ctags.name: _ensure_storage_bucket
ctags.pattern: /^def _ensure_storage_bucket(supabase_url: str, service_key: str, bucket: str, public: bool = Fals/
ctags.signature: (supabase_url: str, service_key: str, bucket: str, public: bool = False)

ctags.name: _exec_sql
ctags.pattern: /^def _exec_sql(supabase_url: str, service_key: str, statement: str) -> Tuple[int, dict]:$/
